## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: request_replan still traverses the REPLAN_REQUIRED gate unchanged, asserted...

The system SHALL ensure that request_replan still traverses the REPLAN_REQUIRED gate unchanged, asserted by an existing gate test passing unmodified.

#### Scenario: request_replan still traverses the REPLAN_REQUIRED gate unchanged, asserted...

WHEN `decide-roadmap-item-failure-handling-on-confidence` is implemented
THEN request_replan still traverses the REPLAN_REQUIRED gate unchanged, asserted by an existing gate test passing unmodified.

### Requirement: Each decision and its distribution are appended to the roadmap checkpoint's...

The system SHALL ensure that each decision and its distribution are appended to the roadmap checkpoint's event log.

#### Scenario: Each decision and its distribution are appended to the roadmap checkpoint's...

WHEN `decide-roadmap-item-failure-handling-on-confidence` is implemented
THEN Each decision and its distribution are appended to the roadmap checkpoint's event log.

### Requirement: The attempt-count ceiling still terminates retries regardless of the chosen...

The system SHALL ensure that the attempt-count ceiling still terminates retries regardless of the chosen label, covered by a test.

#### Scenario: The attempt-count ceiling still terminates retries regardless of the chosen...

WHEN `decide-roadmap-item-failure-handling-on-confidence` is implemented
THEN The attempt-count ceiling still terminates retries regardless of the chosen label, covered by a test.

### Requirement: With the helper returning None, _normalize_outcome's replan boolean governs...

The system SHALL ensure that with the helper returning None, _normalize_outcome's replan boolean governs and current orchestrator failure tests pass unchanged.

#### Scenario: With the helper returning None, _normalize_outcome's replan boolean governs...

WHEN `decide-roadmap-item-failure-handling-on-confidence` is implemented
THEN With the helper returning None, _normalize_outcome's replan boolean governs and current orchestrator failure tests pass unchanged.
